info.title: Toshakino API
info.description:
REST API of the Toshakino store.

- Wire format: JSON, `camelCase`, ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, prices are integers in **Toman**.
- Success: `{"data": ...}`; lists add `"pagination"`.
- Errors: `application/problem+json` with a stable `code` and `traceId` (= `X-Request-Id`).
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

Works for new and existing customers alike (the account is created on first login).

Limits: one code per cooldown period per number, and hourly caps per number and per IP.

post.summary: Log in with mobile number and password
post.description:
Repeated failures lock the number (and the client IP) temporarily with `429`.

The lock also applies to unknown numbers, so it does not reveal which accounts exist.

post.description:
Reads the `refresh_token` cookie. Each refresh token works once; reusing an old one ends
the whole session (`invalid_refresh_token`). Call this single-flight from the client.

cart is emptied, so calling it twice (or without a token) is harmless.

post.summary: Place an order from the cart
post.description:
Creates the order from the current cart and reserves stock (all or nothing).

The shipping cost is priced from the chosen method's rules for the address
(`422 shipping_unavailable` when the method does not serve it). Send an
`Idempotency-Key` so a retried request cannot create a second order.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Random string per checkout attempt (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the same key and body returns the same order (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`).
